title: Check If a String Contains All Binary Codes of Size K
description: Given a binary string `s` and a positive integer `k`, return `true` if every binary string of length `k` (all `2^k` possible codes) appears as a contiguous substring of `s`, and `false` otherwise.
hints: There are `2^k` distinct binary codes of length `k`, so if `s.length - k + 1 < 2^k` you can return `false` immediately.
Maintain a rolling `k`-bit integer mask `code = ((code << 1) & mask) | bit` and track newly seen codes in a boolean array of size `2^k`.
